result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.is_arborescence()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Check if the graph is an arborescence (directed tree). ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L4368-L4459){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.is_arborescence() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} An arborescence is a directed graph which: - must be directed - has exactly one root (a node with in-degree `0`) - has other nodes with in-degree exactly `1` - must be weakly connected - has exactly `n - 1` edges This represents a tree structure with a clear parent-child hierarchy flowing from a single root. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : `True` if graph is an arborescence, `False` otherwise. ::: ## Notes {.doc-notes} For undirected graphs, use `is_tree()` instead. An arborescence is also called a 'directed rooted tree' or 'out-tree'. ## Examples {.doc-examples} Directed tree with single root: ::: {#aacc79ae .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec arb = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_node(label="root") .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge("root", "A") .add_edge("root", "B") .add_edge("A", "C") ) # Returns True arb.is_arborescence() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` True ``` ::: ::: Multiple roots is not an arborescence: ::: {#5e28f107 .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} multi_root = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_node(label="root1") .add_node(label="root2") .add_node(label="A") .add_edge("root1", "A") .add_edge("root2", "A") ) # Returns False (A has in-degree 2) multi_root.is_arborescence() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` False ``` ::: ::: Directed cycle is not an arborescence: ::: {#c88248ba .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} cycle = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge("A", "B") .add_edge("B", "C") .add_edge("C", "A") ) # Returns False (no root, all in-degree 1) cycle.is_arborescence() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` False ``` ::: ::: Balanced tree is an arborescence: ::: {#f94f3b9b .cell execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} tree = ec.Graph(directed=True) tree.add_balanced_tree(k=2, h=3) # Returns True tree.is_arborescence() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=4} ``` True ``` ::: :::
